groupNotes.docs: The most important items — hard to replace or reissue abroad.
groupNotes.devices: Power banks and heat-producing devices must go in your carry-on under aviation safety rules.
groupNotes.clothes: Pack for the weather and whether you can do laundry.
groupNotes.hygiene: Liquids in the cabin: 100 ml or less per container, all in one 1-litre zip bag.
groupNotes.meds: Medicine can be hard to find abroad, so bring small amounts of the basics.
groupNotes.extras: Optional — you can move on without ticking these.

items.passport: Passport (valid for at least 6 months after your departure date)
items.passportCopy: Passport copy + 2 passport photos (keep apart from your passport)
items.ticketVoucher: Flight e-ticket and hotel voucher (saved on your phone + 1 printout)
items.visa: Visa / travel authorization (ESTA, eTA, etc.) — re-check if your destination needs one
items.card: Card that works overseas (e.g. a travel card with low fees)
items.idp: International driving permit (if renting a car; bring your local licence too)
items.insurance: Travel insurance bought · policy saved on your phone
items.powerBank: Power bank (160 Wh or less, max 2 per person)
items.cordlessIron: Cordless hair iron (if the battery detaches, carry only the battery in the cabin)
items.powerStrip: Power strip (if you have many devices)
items.esim: Connectivity: SIM, eSIM QR code, or pocket Wi-Fi
items.outer: Outerwear: light cardigan or windbreaker (for cabin and indoor A/C)
items.shoes: Shoes: broken-in sneakers, room slippers, sandals
items.accessories: Seasonal gear: sunglasses, hat, folding umbrella, parasol, swimwear
items.skincare: Skincare: toner, lotion, sunscreen, sheet masks
items.toiletries: Toiletries: toothbrush, toothpaste, cleanser, shampoo, body wash (use travel bottles)
items.shaver: Razor, nail clippers (best in checked baggage)
items.hygiene: Hygiene: wet wipes, pocket tissues, feminine products, lens solution
items.basicMeds: Basics: cold medicine, pain/fever reliever, digestive aid, anti-diarrhea, motion-sickness pills
items.topicals: Topicals: wound ointment, plasters, insect repellent, bite relief
items.prescription: Personal prescriptions (bring the prescription and an English description)
items.filter: Shower filter: for countries with water-quality concerns
items.pouch: Compression pouches / zip bags: save space, store wet clothes
items.scale: Luggage scale: check your bag weight after shopping
items.pen: Pen: for the arrival card on the plane (keep in your cabin bag)
items.sleepKit: Eye mask, earplugs, neck pillow for long flights

final.intro: One last look so there are no surprises at the airport.

cabin.battery: Cordless hair iron battery, if detachable

final.liquids: Liquids in your carry-on: 100 ml or less each, all in one 1-litre zip bag.
